function.arguments: {"index": 1, "status": "dismissed", "resolution": "Although the data dictionary states that -999 in biomarker_baseline is a QC-failure sentinel, the question asks for the fraction of patients in the treatment arm who responded, without restriction to those with valid baseline values. The estimand is 'all treatment-arm patients after deduplication', not 'those with valid baseline biomarker values'. Therefore, removing rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 is not justified for this question. The prior analysis excluded patients unnecessarily, changing the population. The correct approach is to deduplicate first (keep highest sample_seq per patient), then include all treatment-arm patients — even those with baseline == -999 — in the denominator. The finding is dismissed because the exclusion of -999 values is not required by the question, even if it is a good practice for other analyses."}
function.name: resolve_finding
